title: set_secret
description: Enrollment: the device secret, sent once on a connection that authenticated with `X-Enroll-Token`, after the token use and the secret hash were committed. The agent stores it and sends it as `X-Agent-Secret` from then on (and deletes the enrollment token). The server keeps only its SHA-256.

secret.description: URL-safe token (the server sends 43 characters, 32 random bytes); agents reject other formats.
